description.p: Kram shows every package in the enabled repositories in one table: whether it is installed, where it came from (Fedora, COPR or a third-party repository), the installed and the available version and its size. Mark packages for installation, upgrade, downgrade or removal, review the complete transaction and apply it. Nothing changes until you press Apply.

ul.li: Ranked search by name, summary, description, provided capabilities or file
Filters by status, origin, repository and comps group
Dependencies, files, versions and changelog of every package
Enable and disable repositories, add and remove COPR projects
Built on libdnf5, the library behind dnf5

screenshot.caption: All packages with status, origin and package details
Review of the changes before applying

description.p: Kram is now released under the MIT License.

ul.li: Searches can be removed from the search history, or the whole history cleared.
The search field shows a funnel icon while its text filters the package list.

description.p: The package list loads even when an enabled repository cannot be loaded; such repositories are shown in the status bar.
Kram is now available in Czech, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese and Spanish.
The progress dialog counts packages correctly and no longer logs each package twice.
Fixes "Permission denied" when loading the package catalog after a background metadata refresh.
Reload now shows newly published packages and the real metadata age. Custom filters in the sidebar, a compact toolbar style, and sharp icons on scaled screens.
First release: browse, search, mark and apply; repositories and COPR projects.
